postCreateCommand.fixPerms: CID=$(cat /etc/hostname) && docker exec -u root $CID chmod u+s /usr/bin/sudo 2>/dev/null || true && docker exec -u root $CID chown 1000:1000 /home/streaming 2>/dev/null || true && docker exec -u root $CID chmod 755 /home/streaming 2>/dev/null || true && docker exec -u root $CID chmod 700 /home/streaming/.gnupg /home/streaming/.ssh 2>/dev/null || true && sudo chown -R 1000:1000 . 2>/dev/null || true && sudo mkdir -p /run/user/1000/gnupg && sudo chown -R 1000:1000 /run/user/1000 2>/dev/null || true && ln -sf /tmp/wayland-0 /run/user/1000/wayland-0 2>/dev/null || true
postCreateCommand.gitCfg: git config --global --get safe.directory '*' 2>/dev/null || git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; git config --global init.defaultBranch main && { _k="${GPG_KEY_ID:-}"; [ -n "$_k" ] && git config --global commit.gpgsign true && git config --global user.signingkey "$_k" && git config --global gpg.program gpg || true; }
postCreateCommand.ghAuth: command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 && { gh auth status -h github.com 2>/dev/null || echo 'WARNING: gh credentials stale — run: gh auth login -h github.com'; } || true
postCreateCommand.aliases: echo A | bash /opt/dev-control/scripts/alias-loading.sh 2>/dev/null || echo A | bash ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/scripts/alias-loading.sh 2>/dev/null || true
